copy.tagline_en: Query and configure Codex Rules behavior and rule files
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to understand or adjust Codex rule behavior

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会在会话开始和你发消息时,自动注入项目规则文件(如 CONTEXT.md 等)里的静态指令;在 apply_patch 之后还会按文件匹配补充规则。全程自动,不改写工具输出。
howto.when: 当用户询问 Codex Rules 的行为、项目规则注入或规则文件位置等话题时触发。

say.text: Codex Rules 支持哪些规则文件位置?
怎么用环境变量控制 Codex Rules?
say.note: Claude 会解释 MODE、开关等变量的作用。

say.text: 项目规则会在什么时候注入?
say.note: Claude 会说明在会话开始和每次发消息时注入。

howto.what_en: Claude automatically injects static project rules from supported files (e.g., CONTEXT.md, .claude/rules) at session start and on every user message; after apply_patch, it also adds matching file-specific rules. It runs hands-free and does not alter tool output.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks about Codex Rules behavior, project rule injection, or supported rule file locations, among other related topics.

say_en.text: Which rule file locations does Codex Rules support?
say_en.note: Claude will list paths like CONTEXT.md, .omo/rules.

say_en.text: How can I control Codex Rules via environment variables?
say_en.note: Claude will explain variables like MODE and toggles.
Claude will mention SessionStart and user prompt injection.
